entities.name: Alonso de Fonseca y Ulloa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alonso de Fonseca y Ulloa was a Roman Catholic prelate who served as Bishop of Ávila (1445–1454), Archbishop of Seville, and Archbishop of Santiago de Compostela (1465–1469).
